The '''Nullifier X''' was a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] created by a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]. One such rifle was looted by an unknown [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] from the slain [[N-K Necrosis|Necrosis]].

==Behind the scenes==
The same graphical model of the [[Berserker rifle/Legends|Berserker rifle]] was used for the Nullifier X in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].
